title: Argus - Worktree Agent Session Manager - Visual Studio Marketplace
excerpt: Extension for Visual Studio Code - Worktree-first mission control for Claude Code and Codex sessions.
content_html:
Argus is a worktree-first VS Code cockpit for Claude Code and Codex. Keep your projects, Git worktrees, native agent tabs, changed files, and terminals organized in one window without replacing the provider extensions you already use.

What Argus does

  • Discovers the real Git worktrees belonging to your registered repositories.
  • Starts Claude Code or Codex sessions with the exact worktree as their working directory.
  • Reopens native provider tabs from the session rows under each worktree.
  • Keeps worktree terminals grouped with the work that owns them.
  • Shows changed files for the active worktree and provides basic file operations.
  • Observes provider session state when reliable local evidence is available.

Argus is an organizer and integration layer. Claude Code and Codex continue to own their native chat interfaces, models, authentication, and remote requests.

Getting started

  1. Install the latest VS Code and at least one supported agent extension: Claude Code or Codex.
  2. Open Argus from its eye icon in the Activity Bar. If the current window already contains a project, Argus opens its cockpit in a separate window so it does not replace your project window.
  3. Run Argus: Welcome from the Command Palette if the walkthrough is not already open.
  4. Add a Git repository, select a discovered worktree, and use New Session or New Terminal on that worktree row.

For an Argus-managed session, always use New Session on the Argus worktree row. A provider's own new-chat button does not carry Argus's worktree ownership context.

Requirements

  • macOS on Apple Silicon (darwin-arm64). Argus 0.1 is not published for Windows, Linux, or Intel Macs.
  • VS Code 1.125.0 or newer.
  • Git and a local Git repository.
  • Claude Code 2.1.206 or newer and/or a compatible Codex VS Code extension.

Current limitations

Argus 0.1 is a preview:

  • Argus discovers existing worktrees; it does not create or delete them.
  • Session status is best-effort provider observation and can be unavailable or temporarily stale.
  • Restored Codex tabs can occasionally require a native close/reopen or abort before their displayed state catches up.
  • Provider terminal environment changes may require VS Code's native Relaunch Terminal action.
  • The Active Worktree Files view provides basic create, rename, trash, copy-path, reveal, and drag/drop operations. Rename uses a prompt rather than inline editing.
  • Codex model selection stays inside Codex.

Support

Report bugs and request features through the Argus public issue tracker.

Remove credentials, private prompts, complete provider session files, and repository contents before posting.

Privacy

Argus does not include telemetry or an Argus-operated remote service. It reads local Git, workspace, and provider-session data to build the cockpit. Claude Code and Codex continue to own their authentication, model requests, remote services, and privacy policies.

content_html_zh:
Argus 是 Claude Code 和 Codex 的工作树优先 VS Code 驾驶舱。 将您的项目、Git 工作树、本机代理选项卡、更改的文件和终端组织在一个窗口中，而无需替换您已使用的提供程序扩展。

阿古斯做什么

  • 发现属于您注册的存储库的真实 Git 工作树。
  • 使用确切的工作树作为工作目录启动 Claude Code 或 Codex 会话。
  • 从每个工作树下的会话行重新打开本机提供程序选项卡。
  • 将工作树终端与拥有它们的工作分组。
  • 显示活动工作树的更改文件并提供基本文件操作。
  • 当可靠的本地证据可用时，观察提供者会话状态。

Argus 是一个组织者和集成层。 Claude Code 和 Codex 继续拥有其本机聊天界面、模型、身份验证和远程请求。

入门

  1. 安装最新的 VS Code 和至少一个受支持的代理扩展：Claude Code 或 Codex。
  2. 从活动栏中的眼睛图标打开阿古斯。 如果当前窗口已包含项目，Argus 会在单独的窗口中打开其主控室，因此它不会替换您的项目窗口。
  3. 运行阿格斯：如果演练尚未打开，请从命令面板欢迎。
  4. 添加 Git 存储库，选择发现的工作树，然后在该工作树行上使用“新建会话”或“新建终端”。

对于 Argus 管理的会话，请始终在 Argus 工作树行上使用新建会话。 提供商自己的新聊天按钮不带有 Argus 的工作树所有权上下文。

要求

  • Apple Silicon 上的 macOS (darwin-arm64)。 Argus 0.1 未针对 Windows、Linux 或 Intel Mac 发布。
  • VS Code 1.125.0 或更高版本。
  • Git 和本地 Git 存储库。
  • Claude Code 2.1.206 或更新版本和/或兼容的 Codex VS Code 扩展。

目前的限制

Argus 0.1 是预览版：

  • 阿格斯发现现有的工作树；它不会创建或删除它们。
  • 会话状态是提供商尽力观察的结果，可能不可用或暂时失效。
  • 恢复的 Codex 选项卡有时可能需要本机关闭/重新打开或中止，然后才能赶上其显示状态。
  • 提供商终端环境更改可能需要 VS Code 的本机重新启动终端操作。
  • 活动工作树文件视图提供基本的创建、重命名、垃圾、复制路径、显示和拖/放操作。 重命名使用提示而不是内联编辑。
  • Codex 模型选择保留在 Codex 内部。

支持

通过 Argus 公共问题跟踪器报告错误并请求功能。

在发布之前删除凭据、私人提示、完整的提供者会话文件和存储库内容。

隐私

Argus 不包括遥测或 Argus 运营的远程服务。 它读取本地 Git、工作区和提供者会话数据来构建主控室。 Claude Code 和 Codex 继续拥有自己的身份验证、模型请求、远程服务和隐私策略。
